description.value: Bonus to Perception checks to notice ambient radiation, gas, or spoiled food/water before it becomes a problem.

cinderfall.incomplete: A Perception bonus narrow to noticing ambient radiation/gas/spoiled food has no clean predicate: the real Stonemason's Eye and Scavenger's Search feats use narrow Perception bonuses, but each hooks a real predicate (item:tag:object, or a terrain:unusual-stonework roll option) that already exists in the engine or on real compendium items -- no equivalent 'terrain:radiation' or 'terrain:hazard' roll option exists anywhere in pf2e or in this corpus, so a predicate here would be invented and would silently never fire (a clause is not the claim).
